ApexPage.description: Prints a disbursement's claim sheet as a PDF: line item, budgeted, prior claimed, this claim and remaining, under the disbursement name and its submitted state. Add it to the Funding Disbursement record page, or pass the page name to the Generate PDF action to save it as a file. Starting point only; the header, logo and page furniture are yours to change.
ApexPage.label: Funding Disbursement Print
